abilities._comment: Was a plain STATIC, which nothing dispatches -- the ability never ran. WHILE_STATIC is re-evaluated on every attack-power recalculation. SOURCE_IS_ATTACK confines it to this card's own attack. The condition also asked COUNTER_GTE 'power' -- a POWER COUNTER count, not the card's {p}. 'If this has 6 or more {p}' is the attack's power, which is what the red printing already used.

_comment:
Implementation copied verbatim from flex_strength_blue, whose printed functional text is identical to this card's once each card's own name is substituted out. Everything that differs between them -- cost, pitch, power, colour -- comes from the card DB, not from this file, so the DSL is the same card twice.

THE COPY IS PINNED, not trusted: tests/test_copied_card_implementations.py asserts that these abilities still match flex_strength_blue's and that the two printed texts still agree, so a later edit to one cannot silently leave the other behind. That is the insult_to_injury failure -- three printings of one sentence with three different implementations, the blue one missing a gate the others had.
